speaker: BRO
text: BRO! I haven't slept!  Thirty-one hours in Vice City! Skrrrt!

speaker: NARR
text: What the fuck is wrong with this dude?

speaker: NARR
text: This is Brody.  GTA six came out yesterday.  And Brody hasn't left the game since.

speaker: NARR
text: He saw the security guard's golf cart,  and pressed triangle. In real life.

speaker: GUARD
text: HEY! That's my cart!

speaker: NARR
text: The cart goes four miles an hour.  The guard was walking faster.

speaker: NARR
text: First period. School assembly.  The principal is giving a speech.

speaker: MON
text: Walk, young man! WALK!

speaker: BRO
text: I got two stars! TWO STARS!

speaker: NARR
text: Now he's hiding behind the curtain,  waiting for the stars to go away.

speaker: NARR
text: Then he walks into the nurse's office.

speaker: BRO
text: I need armor. And full health.

speaker: NURSE
text: Sweetie, this is a granola bar.

speaker: BRO
text: Health bar. FULL.

speaker: NARR
text: He's been awake for thirty-one hours.

speaker: NARR
text: Lunch.  I finally sit down with my sandwich.

speaker: BRO
text: Sorry bro. I'm just taking the vehicle.

speaker: NARR
text: He carjacked my sandwich.

speaker: NARR
text: Then he shows me what he's been playing.  It's a stream.

speaker: BRO
text: Yeah. I don't even own it.

speaker: NARR
text: Thirty-one hours.  Watching someone else play.

speaker: NARR
text: The streamer got rich.  Brody got detention.  And my sandwich got carjacked.
